stories.headline: Cybersecurity Experts Ask Feds to Lift Restrictions on Mythos
stories.body: More than 120 cybersecurity and other tech professionals have signed an open letter asking the federal government to lift the export control directives on Anthropic’s Fable and Mythos large language models and commit to a new process for assessing artificial intelligence (AI) risk.
